name: job-search-facilitator
description: A monorepo for the Job Search Facilitator application

scripts.dev:db:seed: pnpm run dev:db && pnpm run prisma:generate && pnpm --filter @job-search-facilitator/core run db:deploy && pnpm --filter @job-search-facilitator/core run db:seed
scripts.dev:db:reset: pnpm run dev:db && pnpm --filter @job-search-facilitator/core run db:reset
scripts.build: pnpm run prisma:generate && pnpm --filter client run build && pnpm --filter server run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run prisma:generate && pnpm -r run typecheck
scripts.lint: pnpm run prisma:generate && oxlint && eslint "packages/**/*.{ts,vue}" --max-warnings=0 && pnpm --filter client run lint:style
scripts.quality: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm run quality && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
